fieldValues.title: Invariants were amended in place with dated markers, not superseded by successors
fieldValues.summary: RFC-034 changes what three existing invariants say. Both the corpus precedent (I-118 amended by RFC-038, I-144 by srs#525) and the visibility requirement in rfc-decision-4431046e point the same way: edit the invariant, mark the edit with a dated amendment marker, and leave the change of position on the decision record that owns it.
evidence: I-118 was amended in place by RFC-038; I-144 by srs#525
rfc-decision-4431046e requires a withdrawn claim to be visibly marked rather than silently removed
I-66, I-118 and I-144 each carry a dated Amended by RFC-034 marker
fieldValues.body: Supersession machinery is for records whose old reading still needs to be readable as something someone relied on. A normative rule that has been narrowed is one rule with a new boundary, and a successor record would leave two live statements of one constraint.
